To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the porous Si-SiO@Fe/C composite with high performance is successfully prepared from the low-cost industrial AlSiFe powders, which can be a promising anode material for lithium ion batteries with high capacity, good rate capability and long cycle life.

a novel Si-SiO@Fe/C composite with high reversible capacity, good cycling stability, excellent rate capability and enhanced Li-ion diffusion coefficient is developed from low-cost industrial AlSiFe alloys.
a new composite material of Si-SiO@Fe/C is prepared using low-cost and easily-available AlSiFe alloy powder as the starting material.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the preparation of a novel high-performance anode material with low cost and high safety for next generation of lithium ion batteries.
the fabrication and application of Si-SiOx@Fe/C composite using industrial, low-cost AlSiFe alloy as precursor for lithium-ion batteries.
the development of novel high-performance anode materials for lithium ion batteries, which is of significance to the practical application of lithium ion batteries.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the Si-SiOx@Fe/C composite with high specific capacity, excellent cycling stability and rate capability can be prepared by a facile and cost-effective process, in which industrial AlSiFe powders are used as raw materials.

the Si-SiO 2 @Fe/C anode materials with a high reversible capacity of 800 mAh g− 1 after 200 cycles at 200 mA g−1 and a high rate capability of 950,900,800,650 and 500 mA h g−1 at a current density of 100, 100, 500,1000 and 1000 mA g−1, respectively, can be obtained using industrial AlSiFe powders.

the Si-SiOx@Fe/C composite prepared by low-cost and available AlSiFe powders as precursor is promising anode material for lithium ion batteries with high capacity, excellent cycling stability and superior rate capability.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

, using the low-cost AlSiFe alloy powder as precursor, we successfully fabricated the novel high-performance Si-SO2@Fe@C composite anode materials by a simple alkali etching and pyrolysis method, which is a low-cost and industrial way to produce the high-performance silicon anodes.

using industrial, low-cost AlSiFe alloy as the precursor and alkali-etching process as the template method, the Si-SiO@Fe/C composite is successfully prepared, which shows excellent electrochemical performances, and the composite anode is expected to be a promising anode material for lithium ion batteries.

the Si-SiOx@Fe/C composite with a porous layered structure is successfully synthesized from industrial AlSiFe powders by a simple alkali etching and following pyrolyzing process, which can exhibit excellent cyclic stability, remarkable rate capability and low transfer resistance.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we can prepare high performance silicon-based composite anode for lithium-ion batteries using industrial, low-cost, and easily available Al-Si-Fe alloy powders.
the low-cost and industrial SiFeAl alloy powders can be a promising alternative to the expensive and high purity silicon powders in fabricating the anode materials for lithium ion batteries.

the Si-SiO₂@Fe/C composite with high capacity and excellent cycling performance can be fabricated by a facile and low-cost process, in which industrial, low-cost, and easily available Al-Si-Fe alloy powders are used as precursors.
